select.text: Talk to me, boss. Welding rig's hot.
Yeah? Clock's ticking, point me at a job.
Arc torch is charged and ready. What's the plan?
Need something bolted together, or taken apart?

job_done.text: Job's done! Not a bad weld if I say so myself.
All finished up, boss. What's next?
Structure's online and solid as bedrock.
Construction complete. That'll hold through an orbital drop.
Wrapped it up! Ready for the next blueprint.

attack.text: Guess this arc welder does overtime on hostiles!
Hold still, I'm gonna spot-weld your armor shut!
Nobody messes with the union! Eat plasma sparks!
This wasn't in my job description, but here we go!

pioneer.direction: Middle-aged man with a thick Texas drawl, mid-low pitch, raspy weather-beaten warmth and a relaxed, dryly funny working cadence.

select.text: Rifle squad standing by. Where's the trouble?
Magazines full, safeties off. Give the word.
Meridian Guard reporting. What's up, Commander?
Just point us toward the target.

move.text: Boots on the move, copy that.

attack.text: Say hello to three-round burst diplomacy!
Free lead delivery, no signature required!
Keep your heads down, or don't, makes my job easier!
Hope they brought an umbrella for this hailstorm!

ready.text: Fresh boots on the ground, Commander.

rifleman.direction: Mature man with a clipped neutral American accent, deep pitch, gruff gravelly voice and the brisk discipline of a career soldier.

select.text: Breacher suit online. Point me at a wall, or a face.
Heavy armor here. What needs smashing?
Concussion shells primed. What's the call?
You rang, Commander? Ready to crack some shells.
Standing by with the big boomers.

attack.text: Knock knock! I brought my own door!
Time for a little high-velocity attitude adjustment!

ready.text: Breacher suited up and ready to wreck!
Heavy shock trooper reporting for duty.

breacher.direction: Young man with a working-class Chicago accent, booming gritty rasp and the punchy confidence of an adrenaline-fueled daredevil.

select.text: Artillery crew online. Give us coordinates.
Howitzer standing by. Want it loud or extra loud?
Ballistics computer ready. What's on the menu?
One-fifty-five millimeter problem solver at your service.

move.text: Rolling the big gun into position.

attack.text: Sending very warm regards from thirty meters away!
Forecast for their grid square: one hundred percent shrapnel!
Special delivery! Catch it with your teeth!
Deleting that coordinate in three, two, one!

ready.text: Howitzer crew rolled out and ready for fire missions!

howitzer.direction: Older man with a flat Midwestern accent, low rumbling gravel and the deliberate delivery of an unbothered artillery veteran.

attack.text: I bite harder than I look.
Those teeth are not for show.

job_done.text: A new pulse in the colony.
One more place to call ours.

forager.direction: Juvenile androgynous creature with a high chittering voice, frenetic darting pace, constantly hungry, words still clear.

attack.text: I am rated for light demolition.
An unexpected use of my toolkit.

mote.direction: Ageless crystalline creature with a light, melodic, high voice, brisk fluid pace and the curiosity of a devoted artisan.

select.text: I've got clean hands and a full kit.

support.text: Save the war story for later.
You'll live to file the report.

triage_specialist.direction: Adult woman with a soft Appalachian accent, crisp and urgent but steady, reassuring and compassionate even under fire.

kestrel_interceptor.direction: Young woman with a brisk California accent, high-mid pitch, quick breathy delivery and the swagger of a high-g pilot.

prospector.direction: Older woman with a dry Australian accent, low cracked dusty rasp, and a wry drawling scavenger's delivery.

select.text: Six seats and a smooth flight.

rampart_transport.direction: Mature man with a Boston accent, thick bass voice and the measured, protective delivery of a grizzled transport driver.

attack.text: Give the dirt a little venom.

needlewing.direction: Female insectoid with piercing pitch, airy hissing sibilants, erratic darting rhythm and a vicious aerial hunter's excitement.

ready.text: The brood has room to grow.

drift_sac.direction: Ancient creature with a subterranean low, bubbling voice, plodding hypnotic rhythm, docile but immense.

move.text: On my way to the line.

lumen_carrier.direction: Mature alien man with velvety resonant low voice, ceremonial delivery and the quiet conviction of a beacon bearer.

select.text: I am ready to look ahead.
A little light for the road.

farsight_wisp.direction: Young alien woman with a breathy, high and luminous voice, gliding rhythm and a detached prophetic mood.

move.text: I leave the clutch in your care.

support.text: Soon you will hear their feet.

brood_keeper.direction: Elder creature matriarch with a deep, resonant guttural voice, measured cadence, and a cruel but maternal attitude.

veilseeker.direction: Adult alien man with a clipped, shadowy mid-low voice, swift cautious pacing and an infiltrator's restraint.

carapace_bulwark.direction: Massive beast with crushing bass, rocky phlegmy texture, dragging pace and blunt, stubborn resolve.

aegis_warden.direction: Ancient alien man with a booming, crystalline voice, ponderous formal cadence and unwavering composure.

attack.text: Let the big hull take it.
Bring the main lens to bear.
Their flagship is in our sights.

crownspire.direction: Ageless alien matriarch, rich regal contralto, measured solemn pace and the authority of a collective speaking in unison.

sporeburst.direction: Androgynous juvenile creature with a wheezing, raspy voice, wet whistling breaths and an excitable manic delivery.

ridge_scout.direction: Young man with a light Southern accent, wiry hushed tone and the hurried caution of an alert recon specialist.

bastion_walker.direction: Venerable alien warrior with a deep, granite-like voice, archaic cadence and a tireless unhurried calm.

rift_engine.direction: Androgynous cybernetic entity with a precise, synthetic mid voice and the clockwork rhythmic cadence of a warp navigator.

select.text: Mirage here. I can scout ahead.

mirage_adept.direction: Young alien man with a mid-pitched, poetic voice, gliding delivery and the playful confidence of an enigmatic duelist.

select.text: The Archive trained me for this.

storm_scribe.direction: Elder alien woman with an incisive high-mid pitch, imperious voice, brisk pacing and the intensity of an elemental scholar.

duskblade.direction: Adult alien woman with an austere, low, razor-thin rasp, swift and disciplined delivery with a hint of remorse.

lattice_archon.direction: Thundering low and gender-ambiguous collective voice, deliberate majestic delivery, a choral quality and immense resonant power.

rupture_crawler.direction: Predatory beast with a low, grinding guttural voice and heavy, lunging rhythm with a crocodilian resonance.

spine_ambusher.direction: Female predator with a venomous whispered voice, dry clicking consonants, and a swift, unnervingly deliberate rhythm.

shade_agent.direction: Adult woman with a subtle Mid-Atlantic accent, low-mid velvety whisper and deliberate, ice-cold precision.

select.text: Pick a route below the radar.

night_harrier.direction: Adult man with a clipped Canadian accent, tight strained baritone and the fast focus of a night-flying stealth pilot.

sky_sentry.direction: Older woman with formal British pronunciation, firm mid pitch, clipped rhythm and a near-metallic controller's authority.

watchkeeper.direction: Senior man with a North Carolina accent, deep smoky gravel and the slow, uncompromising resolve of a frontier marshal.

dreadnought.direction: Older man with Scandinavian-tinged English, a very deep grinding voice and the measured resolve of a ship commander.

cinder_runner.direction: Young man with a Gulf Coast accent and gleeful raspy confidence, fast punchy delivery, like a grease-streaked flame buggy driver.

sentinel_mine.direction: Androgynous autonomous machine voice, quiet and watchful, crisp consonants and perfectly measured phrasing.

vortex_rover.direction: Adult woman with a blunt American accent, low hoarse pitch and the urgent crisp focus of an interceptor crew leader.

atlas_walker.direction: Adult man with a deep Midwestern voice, dry and matter-of-fact, slow enough for precise fire-control calls.

dawn_interceptor.direction: Young alien woman with a bright piercing voice, smooth formal diction and a daring, quick pilot's rhythm.

select.text: Name what the beam should touch.

prism_ray.direction: Alien woman with a bright controlled mid voice, ceremonial vowels and restrained excitement that builds into the attack.

horizon_lancer.direction: Alien man with a solemn rich baritone, measured long-range callouts and a distinct bright edge on consonants.

fleet_carrier.direction: Elder alien woman with a stately contralto, formal diction, and the unhurried authority of an experienced fleet commander.

select.text: There is more than one light.

attack.text: Let them stare at the sun.

ready.text: There is more than one light.

sunseer.direction: Alien woman with a gliding, breathy and luminous high voice, playfully cryptic but precise diction.

select.text: The first stroke is yours to name.

sunblade.direction: Alien man with a deep, musical and fierce warrior's voice, disciplined formality, and sudden emphatic attack calls.

skirmisher.direction: Alien man with a wiry quiet voice, measured consonants and brisk stealthy rhythms, dryly pleased to outmaneuver opponents.

spire_walker.direction: Old alien man with a solemn heavy bass, articulated formal diction, and the patient menace of a siege sentinel.

skitterling.direction: Small frantic insect with a bright, cracked high pitch, rapid clipped syllables, raspy breaths and eager hunting energy.

bile_crawler.direction: Stocky beast with a wet gravel bass, short belchy breaths and an abrupt, irritable rhythm.

select.text: Point me at the dry ones.

blight_hurler.direction: Tall predatory creature with a lean nasal mid pitch, sharp hiss and a malicious, pointed delivery.

spore_seer.direction: Ancient androgynous beast with a slow whispered contralto, nasal wet gurgle and ominously precise words.

brood_mimic.direction: Sly androgynous creature with a pinched voice, mimicking rhythms and little insect clicks behind each clear word.

drift_hauler.direction: Huge docile creature with an airy cavernous bass, slow breaths and an unhurried, wet throat resonance.

select.text: I know where the roots meet.

mireweaver.direction: Elder creature with a conspiratorial low feminine voice, bubbling resonance and creeping, measured cadence.

move.text: I crawl to the feeding ground.

locust_brooder.direction: Burly male creature with a wet buzzing baritone, irregular clicks and deliberate bursts of speech.

siphon_wyrm.direction: Ancient snake-like monster with a narrow gravelly whisper, lingering sibilants and a heavy wet undertone.

corrosion_flyer.direction: Aerial monster with a tense mid-high pitch, coarse hiss, and short, swift calls with a caustic snarl.

select.text: I carry a storm of jaws.

ready.text: I carry a storm of jaws.

brood_siege_flyer.direction: Massive airborne creature with a low booming growl, bubbling resonance and a dragging, ominously deliberate cadence.

locust_flying.direction: Small winged insect with a high buzzing rasp, clipped words, a fast rhythm and breathless excitement before a dive.

broodling.direction: Newly hatched creature with a thin, cracked high voice and sharp, eager bursts that sound like clicks turning into words.

brood_larva.direction: Tiny creature with a high, soft, curious voice, wavering syllables and a hesitant wet chirp before speaking.

captain_vale.direction: A seasoned male field commander from Chicago with a natural, clearly audible Chicago regional accent and Inland North vowel sounds. Strong warm low baritone with light gravel and a slightly weathered voice. Grounded, decisive, clipped radio commands with calm authority, speaking quickly and distinctly. Keep the Chicago accent authentic and understated.

select.text: Vale here. Give me the situation.
I'm with you. Talk to me.

attack.text: Eyes up. I got this one.

ready.text: Fuel topped off. Where's the convoy?
